Card Q&A.a: The effect has already been activated, so the DP boost persists for the turn.
Card Q&A.q: After I use this card’s [When Digivolving] effect to gain +2000 DP for each card with [Armor Form] in its traits in my trash, I use  to trash this card. What happens to the DP boost?

Effect: [When Digivolving] This Digimon unsuspends and gets +2000 DP for each [Armor Form] trait card in your trash until your opponent's turn ends.
